name: City Manager's Office
summary: Runs day-to-day city operations and carries out the policies the City Council sets.
address: 300 W Main St, Juniper Falls, TX, 3rd floor
hours: Mon to Fri, 8 am to 5 pm
about: The City Manager is hired by the City Council and leads the city's 640 employees. The office prepares the annual budget, coordinates departments and answers to the Council in public at every regular meeting.

name: City Secretary
summary: Agendas, minutes, elections, open records and the official city record.
address: 300 W Main St, Juniper Falls, TX, 1st floor
hours: Mon to Fri, 8 am to 5 pm
about: The City Secretary posts every public meeting agenda at least 72 hours ahead, as the Texas Open Meetings Act requires, keeps the minutes, runs city elections and handles requests for public information.

name: Water Utilities
summary: Drinking water, wastewater, billing and the 24-hour leak line.
hours: Billing: Mon to Fri, 8 am to 5 pm. Leaks: 24 hours
about: Water Utilities treats and delivers about 11 million gallons of drinking water a day and runs two wastewater plants. Report a leak or a water main break at any hour on (555) 010-4111.

name: Public Works
summary: Streets, drainage, traffic signals, trash and recycling.
hours: Mon to Fri, 7 am to 4 pm
about: Public Works maintains 410 lane-miles of streets, the storm drain system and every traffic signal in the city, and collects trash and recycling from 29,000 homes each week.

name: Development Services
summary: Building permits, inspections, planning and zoning.
address: 300 W Main St, Juniper Falls, TX, 2nd floor
hours: Mon to Fri, 8 am to 4:30 pm
about: Development Services reviews building plans, issues permits, inspects construction and supports the Planning and Zoning Commission. Most permits can be applied for and paid online through the permit portal.

name: Parks and Recreation
summary: 34 parks, 22 miles of trails, two pools and the recreation center.
address: 2100 Falls Park Dr, Juniper Falls, TX
hours: Rec center: Mon to Sat, 6 am to 9 pm
about: Parks and Recreation looks after 34 parks, the Juniper Creek trail, two pools and the Falls Park recreation center, and runs youth sports, senior programs and summer camps.

name: Public Library
summary: The main library, the Eastside branch and the bookmobile.
address: 410 W Main St, Juniper Falls, TX
hours: Mon to Thu 9 am to 8 pm, Fri and Sat 9 am to 6 pm
about: The Juniper Falls Public Library lends books, laptops and hotspots, runs story times and adult classes, and offers free meeting rooms. A library card is free for anyone who lives, works or studies in the city.

name: Finance
summary: Budget, utility billing, purchasing and municipal court payments.
address: 300 W Main St, Juniper Falls, TX, 2nd floor
hours: Mon to Fri, 8 am to 5 pm
about: Finance prepares the budget with the City Manager, pays the city's bills, issues utility bills and posts every bid and request for proposals.

name: Police Department
summary: Non-emergency line, records, community programs. In an emergency, call 911.
hours: Records: Mon to Fri, 8 am to 5 pm
about: In an emergency, call 911. For anything else, call the non-emergency line at (555) 010-4777. The department also runs neighbourhood watch, the citizens' academy and home-security checks.

name: Fire Department
summary: Fire, rescue and emergency medical services from six stations.
hours: Admin: Mon to Fri, 8 am to 5 pm
about: In an emergency, call 911. Juniper Falls Fire Rescue answers about 9,000 calls a year from six stations. Free smoke alarm installs and car seat checks are available by appointment.
